## Diverging Signals
- **Credit is calm while equities sell off.** HY OAS is only 3.16% and IG OAS 0.83%, with no stress. A pure equity or AI-sector sell-off with tight credit often stays contained. A first widening in spreads would change that.
- **VIX is low relative to VXN.** VIX 17.36 against VXN 22.70 shows the stress is concentrated in Nasdaq/tech, not the whole market. SPX is only 1.6% below its high, while NDX is 4.5% below.
- **Rates eased but equities fell anyway.** The 10Y dropped 0.52% to 5.190%, yet NDX still lost 2.02%. That points to a sector (AI) sell-off, not a rates shock.
- **Dealer flow is turning cautious.** VVIX +10.62% and SKEW at 157.30 say buyers are paying up for protection even though VIX is below 18.

## TQQQ Read
- **Momentum:** RSI(14) is 40.3, neutral but weakening (50.4 at the last read). It is not oversold (below 30). For a put seller there is no mean-reversion help yet, and the three-day slide has no stretch to correct.
- **Market structure:** SIDEWAYS. Spot is 13.1% below the 4-week high ($85.32) and 5.5% above the 4-week low ($70.23). RALLY needs more than 30% above the low (above about $91.30), which is 23.2% away. DOWNTURN needs more than 20% below the high (below about $68.26, −7.9%) AND VXN of 25 or more. VXN is 22.70, so neither holds. The DOWNTURN test is now the closest it has been.
- **Trend:** Mixed. Spot has closed below the 50DMA ($74.59, −0.63%) for the first time in this window. It is still 15.0% above the 200DMA and 15.5% below the 52-week high. The longer uptrend backdrop holds, but the medium-term line is lost.
- **Volatility & premium environment:** VXN is 22.70, up 7.38%. The 3x-VXN estimate is about 68% IV (estimate, not a quote). TQQQ's measured ATM IV and IV/HV are unavailable in this run, so I cannot say whether premium is rich or thin against actual movement. SKEW at 157.30 means downside protection is priced high. Swing risk is high: a −5.95% day shows TQQQ moves about 3 times NDX.
- **Put-selling context: CAUTIOUS.** The backdrop has weakened. TQQQ has lost 5.95% in one day, closed under its 50DMA, and has three red sessions in a row. VXN has crossed 22. Against that, credit is tight, VIX is only 17.36, and TQQQ is still 15% above its 200DMA and 5.2% above its 4-week low. It is not hostile yet. The line to watch is VXN at 25 with TQQQ under about $68.26, which would flip the structure to DOWNTURN.
